name: One Pixel
summary:
One Pixel is a minimalist idle incremental game in which a bouncing pixel grows with every wall hit. Players spend the pixel’s size on upgrades to speed, growth and critical hits, balancing immediate progress against faster growth. Filling the arena unlocks a colour and reveals its corresponding tile in a mystery pattern.

The Original 24 collection features 48 colours and 24 patterns to discover. Prestige resets colour progress in exchange for currency used to purchase upgrades that persist between Prestige resets. Completing a pattern allows players to bank it in their Gallery and Ascend, earning Ascension Points for a separate upgrade system before beginning another randomly selected pattern.

The game includes offline progression, a tap-powered Overdrive mechanic, Experience bonuses and Pattern Mastery. Unlocked colours can also be used to customise the pixel, arena and bottom bar.
